class Box<T> {
  constructor(public next: T) {}
}
interface Loop { next: Loop }
type Forward = Box<Middle>;
type Middle = Box<Inner>;
type Inner = Box<string>;
type BackInner = (Box<string>);
type BackMiddle = (Box<BackInner>);
type Backward = (Box<BackMiddle>);
const source: Forward = new Box(new Box(new Box('forward')));
const reverse: Backward = new Box(new Box(new Box('backward')));
const rejected: Loop = source;
const alsoRejected: Loop = reverse;
console.log(rejected, alsoRejected);
